items.question: What does succession planning consulting include?
items.answer: It covers your succession strategy, critical-role identification, successor and high-potential pipelines, readiness assessment, development plans and leadership transition support, and the talent-review rhythm and metrics that keep the bench strong, as part of your wider talent management, all aligned to the business goals.

items.question: Is succession planning only for the C-suite?
items.answer: No. It covers every critical role and emergency succession for any seat where a sudden departure would hurt the business, from the executive team to scarce technical and operational roles, not just the top of the org chart.

items.question: How long does a succession planning engagement take?
items.answer: Identifying critical roles and assessing successors takes a few weeks; building readiness is an ongoing effort, because succession is a living pipeline reviewed on a rhythm, not a one-off list.

items.question: Do you develop the successors, not just identify them?
items.answer: Yes. The stretch assignments, coaching and development that move successors to ready are the core of the engagement, so a name on the plan becomes a leader who can actually step up.

items.question: What do we get at the end?
items.answer: A critical-role map, a successor pipeline, a readiness grid, development plans and the bench-strength metrics you own and run.
